## Rejected at selection, and why

11 leads that reached candidate development were **not** placed in an episode. Their cards are kept.


| Lead | Title | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| `SL-SQ02-003` | Five hundred carvings nobody has time to look at | No living carving practice at or near Embekke established. Without it this is a monument, not a documentary. |
| `SL-SQ03-008` | Land that did not exist ten years ago | No human subject with anything at stake. Available material is either promotional or oppositional. |
| `SL-SQ05-002` | Living inside a designation | Single commercial property source. The premise that resident families are being displaced by value is plausible and entirely unevidenced. |
| `SL-SQ08-001` | Wood, resin and what fits now | Strong subject area, no located subject. A completed technological transition with nobody found who made it. |
| `SL-SQ08-006` | Judging the heat by eye | No working blacksmith located. Encyclopaedic background is not a subject. |
| `SL-SQ16-003` | A season away on an island | Camps documented only in a personal account and tourism copy. The financing arrangement may involve debt bondage and that was neither confirmed nor excluded; it must not be scheduled on this evidence. |
| `SL-SQ21-005` | A temple thrown into the sea and brought back | Research direction only. A monument with no identified subject and nothing currently happening. |
| `SL-SQ22-002` | Tracing a seed back through the people who kept it | No seed-keeping farmer identified. Health claims in the trade sources are unusable. |
| `SL-SQ22-009` | A community that is mostly a surname now | No family, association or event identified, and the community's own boundaries are contested within the sources. |
| `SL-SQ24-001` | The mask that is allowed to say it | Research direction only. No troupe, village or scheduled performance located, and the form's caste-satire content needs a worked-out position with performers before anything could be filmed. |
| `SL-SQ24-003` | Asking the chart before asking each other | Research direction only. Every source found was a commercial astrology service. No independent evidence of how families actually decide. |

## Held, and why

3 leads are held out of the portfolio. Two of the three concern Tamil communities in the north in disputes with the state; that pattern is a bias in the portfolio, recorded so that the owner decides about it rather than inheriting it.


| Lead | Title | Reason for the hold |
|---|---|---|
| `SL-SQ11-004` | The shop that is also the meeting | Held for insufficient evidence, not for risk. A rural shop is a plausible and attractive setting, but nothing found so far identifies a subject, a situation or anything happening. It is kept because a located shop with something at stake would be a strong episode, and it must not be scheduled on the strength of the setting alone. |
| `SL-SQ22-006` | Refusing the certificate | Real, documented and important, and held out of the episode portfolio at this stage. The 2025 HRW report of police targeting means the ordinary safeguards are not enough. This decision is recorded openly because a pattern is forming: the two leads held so far are both Tamil, northern, and concern the state. That pattern is a bias in the portfolio, not a neutral outcome, and the owner needs to decide about it rather than inherit it silently. |
| `SL-SQ23-005` | Fifty-nine and a half acres | Recorded as a real and well-documented situation, but held out of the episode portfolio at this stage. The risk to participants, the legal position on filming military-held land, and the absence of any non-partisan source all have to be resolved by people on the ground before this could responsibly be scheduled. It is kept rather than deleted because the situation is real and because deleting it would hide a decision that should be visible. |
